text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #111111

g.text: Expected height of boys and girls, from birth to age

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #111111
font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: The bands show the range of heights among children of the same age in the

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: World Health Organization's growth reference population: the middle 50%

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: spans the 25th to 75th percentile, the middle 80% the 10th to 90th, and the

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: middle 94% the 3rd to 97th. Girls are taller than boys, on average, between the

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: ages of about 9 and 13. Up to age 5 these are standards, showing how

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: children grow in good conditions; from age 5 they are a reference, showing

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: how an earlier sample did grow.

text.style: font-size: 8.75px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #888888

g.text: Data source: WHO Child Growth Standards (2006); WHO Growth Reference (2007)
